items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: Joe Ford is another one. He and I had our very first gigs together... It was a trio. It was saxophone, piano, and conga.

ctx.x: Whoa, whoa. What year was that? Well no, no you know what? You know I take it back. I’ll tell you that wasn’t the first time I got paid. The first time I got paid was when I was in high school when I was still playing piano. You know — you’ve heard of Joe Ford, right? Saxophone?
